slides.text: SLIs, SLOs, and SLAs
slides.original_description_html: SLIs, SLOs, and SLAs

slides.text: SLIs A Service Level Indicator is a quantitative measurement that expresses an aspect of the service (commonly a metric).
slides.original_description_html: SLIs A Service Level Indicator is a quantitative measurement that expresses an aspect of the service (commonly a metric).

slides.text: SLOs A Service Level Objective is a target value for a service, as measured via an SLI.
slides.original_description_html: SLOs A Service Level Objective is a target value for a service, as measured via an SLI.

slides.text: SLAs A Service Level Agreement is a contract that defines the results (and consequences) of meeting (or missing) one or more SLOs.
slides.original_description_html: SLAs A Service Level Agreement is a contract that defines the results (and consequences) of meeting (or missing) one or more SLOs.
